# Darmaltoon — Pharmacy Management Software
> Darmaltoon is Windows desktop pharmacy management software designed for Afghan pharmacies.
Website: https://web.darmaltoon.com/
Languages: English https://web.darmaltoon.com/ ; Dari https://web.darmaltoon.com/fa/ ; Pashto https://web.darmaltoon.com/ps/
Product information: https://web.darmaltoon.com/pharmadesktop.html
Features: https://web.darmaltoon.com/features.html
Request a demonstration: https://web.darmaltoon.com/demo.html
Contact: https://web.darmaltoon.com/contact.html

Capabilities: pharmacy sales/POS, medicines and inventory, purchases, suppliers, returns, expiry tracking, daily closing, and operational reports. Offline-first Windows desktop workflows.
Important: Sample dashboard numbers on the marketing site are illustrative, not actual customer results. We do not publish fabricated customer counts or testimonials. Pricing and installation availability are not asserted here; contact the team for current details.
